messages:
sam: heads up — nightly telemetry reprocess for EU shard 42 is blowing up cost. preflight showed ~2.8k token-hrs, operator run is reporting ~5.1k. can we pause & reroute remaining work to a low-cost quantized variant? :thinking:

lina: saw the spike in the console too. preflight and operator CLI disagree on the batch_size/kv_warmup we used. console shows batch=64, operator job used batch=128.

jorge: @sam can you paste the reprocess payload and which routing policy was selected? we need to know if it went through cost-aware or default-priority lane.

sam: payload pasted below — we kicked it from the operator API at 6532109999:
```
POST /v1/reprocess
{
  "shards": [42],
  "window": "2026-03-20T00:00:00Z/2026-03-21T00:00:00Z",
  "batch_size": 128,
  "quant_profile": "auto",
  "routing_hint": "default"
}
```

matt: we should add a dry_run_full_cost flag to the API that simulates runtime batching + kv warming to estimate actual token-hrs more accurately. also expose quant_profile choices to the console.

lina: agreed. UX ask: show per-model + per-region breakdown and an estimated variance (p50/p90). right now the console shows a single flat number — that hides huge tails.

jorge: can router honor explicit intent like `slo: cost` vs `slo: latency` in the reprocess API? currently routing priorities are tenant-tier -> region -> model-variant fallback. we could use an extra field to override.

replay-bot: job 6532109999-42 status: running · progress: 12% · eta: ~2h

sam: thought: divert remaining 88% of work to q4-quant model (est. 2x token reduction). risk = potential metric drift. we should gate by a quick sample eval.

matt: propose a two-step plan: 1) canary 1% of remaining data to quant variant + run eval harness, 2) if pass, switch 80% traffic to quant, keep 20% on baseline for regression monitoring. i'll draft operator runbook.

lina: console changes needed: a "canary quant route" button on active reprocess jobs, with a confirm modal that runs a preflight re-estimate and shows expected delta. need a small UX flow for rollback.

sam: +1. also need an API surface so SRE/ops can trigger programmatically: maybe `PATCH /v1/reprocess/:id/routing` with body `{ "strategy": "quant_canary", "percent": 1 }`.

jorge: follow-ups: this implies an API version bump (v1.1) to avoid surprising older clients. can we implement as opt-in query param `?routing_hint=quant_canary` first?

matt: opened PR for API & console changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/replay/pull/1247 — includes schema for dry_run_full_cost and routing_hint.

lina: i'll add mocks and the confirm modal copy to PR 1247 once matt's branch lands.

replay-bot: job 6532109999-42 progress: 47% · samples_processed: 1,024,000

sam: ok, matt/jorge/lina — can you coordinate on the runbook and target a quick canary in the next 30–45m? i'll hold off any manual cancels until we have the canary patch ready. :ear:
